identity.title: [v0.92][C-SDLC v2][blocker] Reconcile umbrella receipts with v3 source-evidence topology

values.summary: Reconciled the Sprint 2 umbrella validator with exact v3 and bounded real legacy v2 source, evidence, PR-head, merge, and candidate Git topology without weakening terminality or native proof.

Validate generic child WP identity, exact nonzero test target, canonical nested runner, timestamps, command logs, artifacts, negative results, and historical digests.
